summaries.Romania: Romania's government faces a deepening budget crisis with PSD blocking rectification measures while AUR demands accountability, and political tensions escalate around Călin Georgescu's extended arrest. Security concerns mount with cyberattacks on major Romanian institutions and suspected sabotage attempts at defense facilities.
summaries.Healthcare: Eli Lilly's retatrutide ('triple-G' drug) outperforms Ozempic in head-to-head diabetes trials, while healthcare systems grapple with AI adoption barriers and payer policy conflicts over medication access and coverage terminations. Kennedy's MAHA movement pushes unproven peptide compounding as HHS faces pressure over healthcare innovation and affordability.
summaries.Tech: Apple launches its first touchscreen MacBook Pro with OLED display at premium pricing ($2,899-$14,549), while Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon and Microsoft posts record cloud revenue amid intensifying AI competition. Security concerns escalate with major breaches targeting DHS employees and PHP2Shell vulnerabilities affecting 70% of websites globally.

items.title: Călin Georgescu, arest prelungit cu încă 30 de zile. Decizie definitivă a instanței
items.snippet: Călin Georgescu rămâne în arest. Curtea de Apel Bucureşti a decis miercuri prelungirea cu încă 30 de zile a mandatului de arestare preventivă în dosarul de înșelăciune, după ce, anterior, Tribunalul București hotărâse eliberarea sub control judiciar, iar procurorii au făcut contestație. Decizia CAB
items.line: Călin Georgescu's 30-day arrest extension deepens political crisis and triggers AUR street protests, signaling potential governance instability ahead.

items.title: Eli Lilly’s ‘Triple-G’ Drug Tops Ozempic in Head-to-Head Type 2 Diabetes Trial
items.snippet:
Topline Phase 3 results show Eli Lilly’s retatrutide beat Novo’s Ozempic on measures of blood sugar and weight loss in adults with type 2 diabetes. Retatrutide is a peptide designed to activate three metabolic targets versus just one hit by Ozempic. 
The post Eli Lilly’s ‘Triple-G’ Drug Tops Ozempic
items.line: Eli Lilly's retatrutide beats Novo Nordisk's Ozempic in Phase 3 diabetes trial, potentially reshaping the multi-billion GLP-1 market landscape.

items.title: STAT+: As Epic’s dominance grows, its iron grip is choking innovation in health technology
items.snippet: A STAT investigation found that Epic selectively withholds access to patient data, disadvantaging rival software developers and stymying innovation.
items.line: STAT investigation reveals Epic's anti-competitive data withholding stifles health IT innovation and competitor access, raising antitrust concerns.

items.title: Apple Announces OLED MacBook Pro With Touch Display
items.snippet:
Apple today announced a new high-end MacBook Pro, which is available in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes. The new device has a PROLED XDR display that supports touch gestures, and a glowing rear Apple logo.





Pricing on the ‌MacBook Pro‌ starts at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and $3,399 for the 16-inch
items.line: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR starts at $2,899, marking major design shift after decade-long resistance to Mac touch interfaces.

items.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
items.snippet: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
items.line: Microsoft discloses Azure revenue at $33.2B quarterly, revealing how close cloud business is to potentially surpassing AWS in dollar terms.

items.title: What has actually caused the decline in drug overdose deaths?
items.snippet: After years of steep increases, especially amid the pandemic, U.S. overdose deaths decreased 27% in 2024, and preliminary data from 2025 show another meaningful drop.
items.line: US overdose deaths dropped 27% in 2024 despite opioid crisis continuation, suggesting harm reduction and treatment scale-up are showing measurable results.

items.title: Eli Lilly's 340B data policy draws new opposition from Missouri AG, Massachusetts hospitals
items.snippet: A controversial requirement for 340B hospitals to submit claims-level data to earn statutory drug discounts has earned a cease-and-desist letter from Missouri's attorney general and yet another lawsuit from disgruntled hospitals.
items.line: Missouri AG and Massachusetts hospitals challenge Eli Lilly's 340B claims-data requirement, signaling regulatory pushback on drug discount program conditions.

items.line: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with enhanced cybersecurity and coding capabilities, intensifying frontier AI model competition with Anthropic and OpenAI.

items.title: A hacker stole more than 40,000 DHS employee records
items.snippet: A hacker stole a trove of personal information from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). items.line: Hacker breached 41,000+ DHS employee records including ICE/CBP agents, exposing critical infrastructure vulnerability in US government cybersecurity.

items.title: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
items.snippet: The PHP scare may have faded from your feed, but the cleanup is far from over. Last week, two critical bugs in the open source language behind roughly 70% of websites left organizations scrambling to fix their systems, with some taking sites offline until the vulnerabilities could be patched. items.line: PHP2Shell vulnerabilities affect 70% of websites globally, creating 'vulnpocalypse' risk as organizations scramble to patch critical open-source flaws.
